concept_name: Bluewater Twin 45 — expedition hybrid power catamaran

mission.mission_statement: A long-range expedition power catamaran with quiet port modes, broad deck utility, shallow-water access where appropriate, comfortable offshore motion, maintainable twin machinery and strong degraded-operation capability.
mission.operating_region: Ocean/coastal expedition routes with declared weather avoidance, refuge and draft constraints; no polar/ice operation presumed.
mission.route_profile: Long displacement/semi-displacement passages with low-speed hotel/anchorage operation, tender handling, resupply and route-specific fuel/shore-power scenarios.

target_cruise_speed_kn.rationale: Provisional passage-speed target; propulsion demand must be computed against a hull/propulsor model.

target_range_nmi.rationale: Provisional range including a reserve policy to be formalised.

voyage_duration_days.rationale: Initial endurance and store/maintenance stress scenario.

passenger_capacity.rationale: Working guest capacity for the mission profile; final arrangement and safety review required.

crew_capacity.rationale: Mission, systems complexity, service level and safe manning determine crew complement.

payload_capacity.rationale: Tender, stores, science/work payload, fuel, batteries and consumables need a weight budget.

length_overall_m.rationale: Concept scale for an expedition power catamaran.

overall_beam_m.rationale: Constrained by port, stability, structure, cross-deck loading and superstructure windage.

demihull_beam_m.rationale: Set from required payload, tankage, machinery, slenderness and low-speed hull resistance.

hull_centerline_spacing_m.rationale: Central design variable; optimise both wave interference and transverse/cross-deck consequences.

hull_spacing_over_lwl.rationale: Do not select a dimensionless optimum outside demonstrated benchmark domain.

design_draft_m.rationale: Determine for propulsors, appendages, displacement, port access and loaded reserve.

wet_deck_clearance_m.rationale: Set by route wave climate, bridge-deck impacts and superstructure/CG trade.

wet_deck_clearance_over_draft.rationale: Dimensionless screening variable to measure against encounter wave and loading cases.

displacement_tonnes.rationale: Full mass, fuel, battery, stores, payload and growth-margin model required.

demihull_slenderness_lwl_over_beam.rationale: Must co-optimise resistance, tankage, structure, propulsor integration and usable volume.

geometry.hull_form_hypothesis: Compare slender displacement and moderate semi-displacement twin hull families with multiple bow reserve-volume and stern/propulsor arrangements.
geometry.volume_distribution_hypothesis: Optimise trim and reserve buoyancy under lightship, full fuel/stores, tender, payload and uneven loading.

hydrodynamics.hull_interference_method: Sweep hull-spacing and demi-hull-form variables over speed/loading; measure interference versus a monohull and isolated-hull baseline without extrapolating one best point.
hydrodynamics.resistance_method: Separate viscous/frictional, wave-making, appendage and propulsor terms only where the model supports them; use matched ITTC-style validation and keep error bars.
hydrodynamics.propulsor_configuration: Compare twin propellers, pods or other appropriate propulsion with redundancy, cavitation/noise, shallow-water, serviceability and manoeuvring constraints.
hydrodynamics.foil_configuration: No lift foils in baseline; optional foil-assist remains a separate variant requiring impact/failure analysis and independent gains accounting.
reference_cases: Delft 372 resistance/trim/sinkage and hull-spacing studies as a methodology anchor only; not same displacement/design or direct full-scale performance.
ITTC resistance/propulsion validation database; exact compatible case and license must be checked.
hydrodynamics.uncertainty_method: Separate numerical, model-form, measurement, load/weather, fouling and scale/applicability uncertainty; validate each speed regime and loading condition.

seakeeping.wave_climate_basis: Build region-specific scatter diagrams and route encounters; include irregular waves, headings, currents and loading variation.
seakeeping.wet_deck_impact_method: Predict dynamic clearance and pressure/impact response with uncertainty; verify shortlisted candidates using model tests or validated time-domain methods.
seakeeping.ride_comfort_method: Quantify vertical/lateral acceleration, motions, noise and vibration at guest/crew locations across declared routes and speed choices.

structure_and_safety.cross_deck_load_path: Develop global cross-deck bending/torsion and local wet-deck pressure load paths for wave, asymmetric buoyancy, machinery and superstructure loads.
structure_and_safety.fatigue_method: Define lifetime wave/propulsor/engine vibration spectra; inspectable details and maintenance allowances required.
structure_and_safety.asymmetric_flooding_method: Analyse independent hull flooding, cross-flooding risk, compartmentation, residual stability and safe degraded operation.
structure_and_safety.stability_method: Qualified intact/damage stability across tank/loading/sea states, tender loading, high windage and damage conditions.
structure_and_safety.foil_failure_mode_method: Not applicable to the non-foiling baseline; if foil-assist is introduced it must be assessed as a separate fail-safe architecture.
structure_and_safety.redundancy_and_degraded_modes: Independent propulsion/control/power paths; assess single machinery failure, steering failure, black-start, fire segregation and safe return.
structure_and_safety.approval_basis: Determine applicable flag/class rules, route, passenger/crew category and intended operation with qualified naval architects.

propulsion_candidates: twin efficient diesel or renewable-fuel-capable propulsion baseline
diesel-electric hybrid with battery peak shaving and silent port mode
battery-electric for restricted route segments only where energy/mass/charging close
energy_carriers: methanol or hydrogen as bounded future-fuel studies subject to safety/volume assessment

battery_capacity_mwh.rationale: Size only after route power map, quiet-mode duration, battery aging, reserve, cooling/fire zone and mass closure.

energy_architecture.mode_resolved_load_basis: Build 15-minute or finer loads for passage speeds, hotel/quiet mode, manoeuvring, tender handling, freshwater/waste systems, peak HVAC, generator loading and emergencies.
energy_architecture.shore_power_or_charging: Model only specific ports with verified connection rating, dwell times, grid constraints and seasonal availability.
energy_architecture.renewable_assist: Assess solar and wind assist as route- and geometry-dependent increments after structural, stability, maintenance and aerodynamic/foil effects are considered.
energy_architecture.emissions_boundary: Provide tank-to-wake and well-to-wake GHG, upstream energy factors, fuel logistics and battery/fuel-system lifecycle sensitivity.
energy_architecture.reserve_policy: Set mission reserve, safe divert range, one-generator/one-propulsor degraded case, battery reserve and fuel uncertainty.

payload_and_operations.mission_payload: Tender/mission equipment, provisions, water, fuel, batteries and guest payload share the same mass, deck load and centre-of-gravity budget.
payload_and_operations.port_or_mooring_envelope: Verify overall beam, draft, windage, mooring/tender access and service/charging availability for intended destinations.
payload_and_operations.maintainability: Arrange twin machinery and electric/battery compartments for independent service and safe isolation; account for remote parts and specialist repair.
payload_and_operations.crew_workload: Assess bridge/engineering manning, engine monitoring, tender operations, anchoring, redundancy transitions and emergency actions.
payload_and_operations.emergency_access: Cross-deck and hull compartments need accessible escape/isolation; preserve rescue boat/tender launch, firefighting and abandon-ship arrangements.

availability_target.rationale: Provisional expedition mission target; verify with redundancy, spares, maintenance and route model.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Matched same route, payload, speed, comfort, auxiliary service and reserve.
performance_targets.validation_method: Lifecycle fuel/electricity factors plus validated mission energy model.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Declared loading, weather, fouling, fuel quality and reserve.
performance_targets.validation_method: Validated resistance/power map plus time-series load/fuel balance.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Same guest-service/HVAC loads and acceptable noise levels.
performance_targets.validation_method: Measured hotel loads and acoustic tests; state battery reserve and ambient environment.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Stability, cross-deck slam, single machinery failure, route/draft, emissions and energy reserve negative controls.
performance_targets.validation_method: Evaluator-hidden truth and qualified hard constraints; no compensatory scalar score.

hard_constraints.description: Intact/damage stability across loading, tank, asymmetric flooding and wave conditions.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Qualified calculations, applicable criteria and flag/class review.

hard_constraints.description: Cross-deck bending, torsion, fatigue and wet-deck impact loads.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Design load cases, validated hydrodynamic pressures and structural/fatigue verification.

hard_constraints.description: Safe propulsion, steering and essential power under defined single failures.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Reliability, FMEA and degraded-mode tests with qualified approval.

hard_constraints.description: Emissions and discharge compliance for declared routes and ports.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Applicable MARPOL/flag/port compliance matrix and evidence.

hard_constraints.description: Draft, beam, port, anchorage, weather and rescue/refuge envelope.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Verified route/port GIS, wave scatter diagrams and operations procedures.

hard_constraints.description: Fuel/battery fire, ventilation, containment, escape and independent isolation.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Energy-system hazard analyses and class/flag review.

assumptions.statement: A slender twin-hull platform can provide useful deck volume and shallow-draft access without excessive wave interaction or structure mass.
assumptions.falsification_method: Compare matched-payload candidates across beam, spacing, draft, resistance, structural weight and route access.

assumptions.statement: Hybrid electric dispatch and quiet modes can reduce fuel/emissions without over-sizing battery capacity.
assumptions.falsification_method: Use measured or validated time-series hotel/propulsion loads with degradation, reserve, and lifecycle pathway factors.

assumptions.statement: A single catamaran geometry can meet both long-passage efficiency and useful port/low-speed handling.
assumptions.falsification_method: Evaluate full mission envelope and separate operational variants where no robust common optimum exists.

provenance.title: CFD validation for Delft 372 Catamaran in static drift conditions
provenance.scope: Reference methodology for calm-water drift, loads, sinkage/trim, PIV and wave-pattern validation; geometry/conditions must match before quantitative use.

provenance.title: Experimental catamaran head-wave benchmark with uncertainty quantification
provenance.scope: Regular and irregular head-wave responses and statistical uncertainty analysis; source record notes access restrictions, so do not redistribute source data without permission.

provenance.title: ITTC CFD validation benchmark database for resistance and propulsion
provenance.scope: Procedure describing selection and use of resistance/propulsion CFD validation cases; not blanket permission to redistribute linked data.

provenance.title: IMO High-speed craft safety framework
provenance.scope: Applicability and overview of HSC Code for qualifying high-speed craft; route and vessel-specific applicability review required.

provenance.title: IMO ship design and stability
provenance.scope: Public overview of SOLAS ship design, subdivision and stability requirements; not a complete compliance checklist.

provenance.title: Condor/Artemis EF-24 electric ferry project report
provenance.scope: Project-reported 24 m hydrofoil ferry concept with up to 150 passengers, 100 nmi and 38 kn; comparison anchor only, not independent validation.

claim_ceiling: Concept hypothesis only. No resistance, full-scale range, wave limit, structural strength, stability, seaworthiness or class approval is established.
